practices: Freeze renderer/paint while comparing pose hypotheses; name the axis as overlap, lower clasp, free-hand negative space or offering orientation.

Carry forward prior deductions using verified hashes, then mark each as fixed, partially improved or unchanged. Whole-foundation scores must not silently become delta-only scores.

Future website engineers should adapt attention to the actual target and maintain a quiet scene; source continuity and cached layout are engineering evidence, while perceived meaning remains a separate test.
exceptions: Intentional multi-second character acting is not compressed into generic sub300ms UI feedback or disabled on keyboard Play.

Archive comparison surfaces and sources as required review evidence; prototype cleanup does not delete authorized provenance.
Technical tests, source bearings and sampled films do not prove fluidity, physical-phone experience, spoken AT or human attachment.
